Reporting to the Data Privacy Compliance Lead, this role collaborates across the organization to help ensure personal data is collected, processed, and stored in line with applicable privacy laws and  DeepHealth  requirements.  Essential Duties and Responsibilities   
  Support organizational data privacy efforts and help ensure compliance with applicable local, national, and global privacy laws and regulations.  
  Assist with the Privacy by Design program supporting product development and modification, including software and AI use cases.  
  Collaborate with Vendor Management on vendor qualification and on implementation of Data Processing Agreements and Transfer Impact Assessments as applicable.  
  Research and review country-specific data privacy frameworks and regulations to support continued compliance and business opportunities.  
  Collaborate cross-functionally to implement technical and organizational measures that support data privacy.  
  Monitor how personal data is collected, processed, and stored for compliance with applicable laws.  
  Participate in investigations and impact assessments related to information security events with privacy implications.  
  Serve as a backup point of contact for data protection authorities and data subjects, handling inquiries and requests.  
  Collaborate cross-functionally to improve data privacy processes in support of risk management frameworks such as GDPR and HIPAA.  
  Maintain clear documentation of privacy activities and support audit and regulatory readiness as assigned.  
  Requirements  Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience  
  Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience (required).  
  Minimum of 2 years of experience in a regulated industry (required); medical device experience preferred.  
  Software and/or Software as a Medical Device experience preferred.  
  Strong knowledge of GDPR and HIPAA (required).  
  Excellent written and oral communication skills (required).  
  Preferred: Experience supporting privacy assessments, DPAs, or Privacy by Design activities.  
  Quality Standards  
  Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors and vendors.  
  Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.   
  Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.  
  Follows all  DeepHealth  policies and procedures.  
  Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.  
  Practices universal safety precautions.  
  Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.  
  Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.  
  Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with  DeepHealth  guidelines.  
  Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Our EHS+ platform converges people, data, and AI agents to provide a clear view of information people can trust, automate workflows that make people more impactful, and deliver personalized insights and expertise to improve decision-making. While most solutions respond to risks one at a time,  Cority  helps prevent them across environmental management, employee health, safety, quality, and sustainability. Reporting to the Manager, FP&A, you'll own forecasting and reporting for partner departments, build key inputs to our monthly board pack, and act as the day-to-day finance partner to department heads. This is a hands-on, driver-based modelling role suited to someone who wants exposure to SaaS/recurring-revenue metrics (ARR, NRR, GRR) and cross-functional finance work. What You'll Do  
 Support the annual budgeting and department forecast processes — gather business-partner inputs, update models, and flag variances above threshold 
 Support Professional Services reporting — track utilization, backlog, and POC revenue, and assist with the PS forecast and capacity plan 
 Prepare board pack components, including variance tables and KPI charts 
 Provide accrual inputs to accounting and support post-close flux analysis 
 Reconcile actuals to forecast each month-end 
 Act as finance partner to a department head, including attending the monthly BVA (budget-vs-actual) analysis meeting 
 Assist with scenario and sensitivity analysis under the Manager's direction 
  What We're Looking For  
 Comfort building and maintaining driver-based financial models 
 Ability to write clear variance commentary, not just build the variance table 
 Strong operating discipline — reporting calendars, version control, and attention to detail 
 SaaS or recurring-revenue background preferred; familiarity with ARR, NRR, GRR, and ARR-to-billings-to-GAAP-revenue bridges is a plus 
 Familiarity with the Professional Services function at a SaaS company is a plus 
 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field 
 1–3 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or a related analytical role 
 Advanced Excel skills; experience with a budgeting/forecasting platform (e.g., Pigment, Drivetrain, Vena) is a plus 
  WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?  
 An opportunity to work in a values-driven, performance oriented, dynamic and growth focused culture 
 We support a remote working environment with a one-time home office allowance and subsidized monthly internet allowance 
 Competitive health benefits, dental plans, and retirement savings plan (RRSP, 401K plan etc.)

 Access to learning tools & platforms, internal training programs, annual training allowance and certifications (if applicable), and High Talent Programs
